svg.title: One decode token, from the host to the hardware and back
svg.desc: Three bands, host, firmware on the RISC-V control core and hardware, with seven numbered steps. 1: llama.cpp builds the ggml graph and ggml-tesseract turns it into a cached op list; the weights already sit in card DDR. 2: the transport writes the token inputs to DDR and pushes one launch descriptor over PCIe. 3: the runtime takes the launch and the Basis graph kernel walks the op list. 4: the kernel issues tile ops through the issue path and unit queues. 5: DMA streams weights from four DDR4 channels into four MVM clusters; the vector unit and attention ops work in the 4 MiB SPM; the KV cache stays in DDR. 6: results go back to DDR and the runtime posts an answer record. 7: the host reads the answer and the logits.
